text:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Pager: high error rate on /v1/embeddings (region-us-east). Auto-escalation to oncall.
Alice (oncall): I'm on it, pulling logs now. seeing 5xx from embedder service.
Alice (oncall): quick check: rolling restart of embedder-prod-2 reduces error rate? trying now.
Raj: copying in SRE. if restart doesn't stabilize, we should route traffic to embedder-prod-1 and start failover.
Alice (oncall): restart completed, partial improvement but 95th percentile still elevated. tail latency spikes every ~30s.
Theo: sounds like an intermittent KV cache eviction on the GPU nodes - saw similar pattern last quarter. Can you grab kernel logs?
Alice (oncall): attaching logs snippet: ```kernel: evict triggered shard_id=7 ctx=kvcache size=4.2G```
Emily: adding that to the live mitigation checklist: 1) route, 2) restart, 3) increase cache TTL, 4) mitigation hook to fallback model.
Carlos: heads-up from product: a small group of customers on Dedicated may have seen failed embeddings for ~7-10 min. Do we have customer impact estimate?
Maya: estimating now — initial sampling shows ~120 requests failed across 3 customers, two were high-throughput tenants. We'll capture exact list and flag CS.
Raj: mitigation plan: route 30% to warm standby (prod-1), increase kvcache TTL to 6h on affected pool, and disable aggressive eviction. I'll coordinate the router tweak.
Alice (oncall): done routing change. error rate down to baseline. documenting in incident channel.
IncidentBot: Incident acknowledged as SEV3. Start time 1749001234. Mitigation acknowledged at 1749003120.
Carlos: good job. Next steps: schedule post-incident review and create action items. Who can own the postmortem write-up?
Theo: I can draft the technical postmortem and include the KV cache root cause analysis. Will need runtime metrics + kernel traces.
Maya: I'll handle customer impact and CS notes, and coordinate outreach for the affected Dedicated tenants.
Emily: I'll open remediation tickets for the runtime fixes and infra guardrails. Proposing tickets: RB-501 (kvcache-ttl-default), RB-502 (router-fallback-testing), RB-503 (embedder-observability).
Alice (oncall): assign RB-501 to Theo (owner), RB-502 to Raj, RB-503 to Emily.
Raj: rough sizing: RB-501 = M (4 dev-days), RB-502 = S (2 dev-days + router rollout), RB-503 = L (8 dev-days for dashboards + alerts).
Carlos: prioritize RB-503 and RB-501 in next planning cycle. If we tag by severity: kvcache fix = P1, observability = P1, router tests = P2. Tie RB-501 and RB-503 to Q2 reliability sprint.
Theo: estimated ETA for postmortem draft: EOD tomorrow. Will include sequence diagrams and mitigation timeline.
Maya: I'll prepare a short CS brief by EOD as well.
Emily: I'll create the tickets now and add acceptance criteria and tests. Carlos, can you confirm we should start championing RB-503 for Q2?
Carlos: yes, go ahead. I'll flag for the quarterly planning meeting and add it to the reliability sprint board.
Alice (oncall): action items recap:
- Theo: draft technical postmortem (due: +1 day) [RB-501 owner]
- Maya: customer impact + CS outreach (due: +1 day)
- Emily: create remediation tickets RB-501/2/3 with AC/tests (due: today)
- Raj: add router fallback regression tests and plan rollout (est 2 days)
- Carlos: flag RB-501 and RB-503 for Q2 reliability sprint and add to planning backlog.
Raj: tagging severity for tracking: incident SEV3 -> remediation priority P1 for RB-501 & RB-503.
IncidentBot: Postmortem scheduled: Draft required by 1749080000. Postmortem meeting scheduled 1749120000 in #all-hands-calendar.
Alice (oncall): thanks everyone. logging this thread into the incident board now: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-1749
Carlos: small follow-up — let's add a KPI check to the postmortem: cost delta when shifting 30% of traffic to standby and potential perf regression windows.
Theo: noted. I'll include cost/perf delta and also run a replay test on prod-1 tomorrow morning.
Maya: closing loop: CS will wait for the postmortem summary before customer comms, unless urgent.
Emily: tickets created: RB-501, RB-502, RB-503. links added to incident ticket. marking owners and sizing.
Alice (oncall): closing live mitigation. if anything regresses, page again. :thumbsup:
